methods.label: Work backward through Cindy’s calculation
methods.explanation:
Undo Cindy’s operations in reverse order to recover the original number. Her last step divided by \(3\) and produced \(43\), so the number just before division was
\[
43\cdot3=129.
\]
She obtained \(129\) by subtracting \(9\), so the original number was \(129+9=138\).

Now carry out the intended operations: subtract \(3\), then divide by \(9\):
\[
\frac{138-3}{9}=\frac{135}{9}=\boxed{15}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
